name.ja: ＨＧ スコープドッグ用拡張パーツセット5
name.en: HG EXPANSION PARTS SET 5 for SCOPEDOG

ja: 2023年10月店頭販売アイテム「ＨＧ スコープドッグ」（別売り）、
2024年5月店頭販売アイテム「ＨＧ バーグラリードッグ」（別売り）連動アイテムが登場！
※この商品にHG スコープドッグ、HG バーグラリードッグ本体は含まれません。
悠久なる戦いの連鎖、君は何処を彷徨い、何を思う－
HG スコープドッグ、バーグラリードッグをさらに楽しむオプションパーツが拡張セットとして登場！
劇中の機体を再現できる各種パーツが同梱！
〈 セット内容 〉
●　バーグラリードッグ脚部ユニット
●　ブルーティッシュドッグ脚部ユニット
●　ドッグマン専用機用フロントアーマー
●　カラーバリエーションランナー
●　カスタマイズ用外装パーツ（薄緑ランナー）
＜スコープドッグを支える多彩な装備が付属！＞
・バーグラリードッグ脚部ユニット
バーグラリードッグが装備していたトランプルリガーを装備した脚部が付属し、展開を再現。
・ブルーティッシュドッグ脚部ユニット
ブルーティッシュドッグが装備していた大型グライディングホイールを
装備した脚部を本体パーツに組み込んで再現。
・ドッグマン専用機用フロントアーマー
通常のフロントアーマーより大型化されたものが付属。
・カラーバリエーションランナー
本体薄緑ランナーの一部を濃緑に変えたランナーが付属。
・カスタマイズ用外装パーツ
3mmジョイントとの互換性を高めるカスタマイズ用外装パーツも一部付属し、幅広いカスタマイズを楽しめる。
同梱内容
・胴体薄緑部
腿のパーツ分割をアップグレードしたパーツ等が付属。
付属品：　拡張パーツ一式 ／ カスタマイズ用外装パーツ（薄緑ランナー）
当商品は、2023年10月店頭販売アイテム「ＨＧ スコープドッグ」（別売り）
2024年5月店頭販売アイテム「ＨＧ バーグラリードッグ」（別売り）
と組み合わせる‘拡張パーツ’のセットです。

en: ■ Introducing linked items for the October 2023 store sales item "HG Scope Dog" (sold separately) and the May 2024 store sales item "HG Burglary Dog" (sold separately)! *This product does not include HG SCOPEDOG or HG BURGLARYDOG itself. The eternal chain of battle, where are you wandering, what are you thinking? Optional parts to enjoy HG SCOPEDOG and Burglary Dog even more are now available as an expansion set! Various parts that can be used to recreate the machine in the play are included!  ● Burglary Dog leg unit ● Brutish Dog leg unit ● Front armor for Dogman's exclusive machine ● Color variation runner ● Exterior parts for customization (light green runner)  ・ Burglary Dog leg unit The legs equipped with the trample rigger that was equipped on the Burglary Dog are included, and the deployment is reproduced. ・ Brutish Dog leg unit The legs equipped with the large gliding wheels that were equipped on the Brutish Dog are incorporated into the main body parts to reproduce.・Front armor for Dogman's exclusive machine A larger version of the normal front armor is included. ・Color variation runner A runner with part of the main body's light green runner changed to dark green is included. ・Customizable exterior parts Some customizable exterior parts that increase compatibility with 3mm joints are also included, allowing for a wide range of customization. Package contents ・Light green torso Includes parts with upgraded leg part divisions. Accessories: Set of expansion parts / Customizable exterior parts (light green runner) ---------------------------------------------------------------- This product is a set of 'expansion parts' to be combined with the October 2023 store item "HG Scope Dog" (sold separately) and the May 2024 store item "HG Burglary Dog" (sold separately). * This product does not include HG SCOPEDOG or HG BURGLARYDOG body. * To recreate the photos shown, this product and an unassembled "HG Scope Dog" or "HG Burglary Dog" (each sold separately) are required. -------------------------------------------------- Non-scale assembly-type plastic model Recommended age: 15 years and older Product material: PS ・No adhesive is used for assembly -------------------------------------------------- *The finished product in the photo is painted. It is also a prototype under development. It may differ from the actual product. *Air bubbles may be present in the clear parts due to the manufacturing process. *The product material may change depending on the production period of the product. Please note. *Plated parts may vary due to the painting process. Please note. *The quantity available for purchase may change depending on the sales situation. (Notes) ・ This product cannot be purchased at stores that sell plastic models. ・ This product may be sold at events hosted by our company, other projects, and overseas. ・ The number of this product available for sale at 'Premium Bandai' is limited. We apologize if it is out of stock. ・ Due to the number of products prepared for production, the number of products that can be purchased per person is limited. Thank you for your understanding. ・ The number of products that can be purchased may change in the future depending on the sales situation. ・ The shipping date of this product may change depending on the application status and production circumstances. Please note. ・ Product images are under development and may differ from the actual product. ・ Product information is current as of May 2024. Packaging, logos, and product specifications are subject to change without notice.
